name: Hidan
background: Hidan is a missing-nin from Yugakure and the only known follower of Jashin, a deity who demands ritual sacrifices. He is known for his immortality, which allows him to survive fatal wounds.

abilities.name: Ritual of Jashin
abilities.description: Hidan uses his opponent's blood to link their fates, allowing him to inflict pain on them by harming himself.

abilities.name: Curse Technique: Death Controlling Possessed Blood
abilities.description: The technique that enables the Ritual of Jashin. Requires Hidan to draw a symbol of Jashin on the ground.

abilities.name: Immortality
abilities.description: Grants Hidan the ability to survive mortal wounds, such as decapitation or impalement.

abilities.name: Triple-Bladed Scythe
abilities.description: A custom weapon used by Hidan to injure opponents and collect their blood for his rituals.

relationships.name: Kakuzu
relationships.dynamic: Partnered with Kakuzu in the Akatsuki. They had an antagonistic relationship but worked well together due to their respective immortality and durability.

relationships.name: Jashin
relationships.dynamic: Hidan's deity. He performed ritual sacrifices to honor Jashin and gain immortality.

quotes.text: Now! Let's savour the utmost of suffering together!
Every damn time… That's not something you say to me… If they can kill me, I couldn't be happier. Although… I don't think they can!
quotes.context: To Kakuzu after being told not to die.

quotes.text: Hell that hurts… You go and stab me all over… Damn both of you… Divine judgement awaits heathens ignorant to the pain of others.
Yeah hurts good doesn't it? Attacking the vitals is such a waste! This pain, this is the best! As the other dies, their agony radiates through my body! And living through it feels even better!
I'll never die… Even if you destroy my body, and I'm left with nothing but my head… I'll escape somehow… and when I do, I'll find you and bite your throat out!
quotes.context: To Shikamaru before being buried alive.
